review_mode: read-only source audit and read-only inspection of saved offline evidence

scope.hash_provenance: Exact full-file pins read from controlled-source-manifest-r1.json and tests-report-r1.json; reviewer independently read source blocks but did not independently recompute file hashes.
inspected_blocks: public r26 preparation-driver.py schema and merge logic

verified_source_boundaries.evidence: Manifest path and SHA must both be supplied or both absent. getattr compatibility supports original args. Absent proof returnsNone, omits report.private_profile_review and retains PRIVATE_PROFILE_MERGE_UNPREPARED; no private proof files are opened on that branch.

verified_source_boundaries.property: Private packet isolation and fixed schema
verified_source_boundaries.evidence: Manifest is fixed review.json; packet is outside source/publication/backup paths and Git checkouts, with exactly review.json, candidate-profile.yaml and candidate-installed.json. Manifest keys must exactly equal PROFILE_REVIEW_KEYS.

verified_source_boundaries.property: Credential alias refusal before private artifact read/hash
verified_source_boundaries.evidence: Path/inode aliases are refused; token lstat must be current-owner private single-link regular0400/0600. Initial token dev/ino is retained. Opened candidateFD and current token lstat are compared before rawread, then token identity is checked again before artifact digest. Token is never opened/read/hashed by the private artifact helper. Symlink token references are refused.

Immediate parent must be current-owner exact0700 before artifact open. Open uses O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK via S.open_parent. Artifact must be current-owner exact0600 single-link regular. Bounded read, sameFD before/after, linked-name dev/ino/size/mtime/ctime/uid/nlink/fullmode and parent dev/ino/uid/fullmode checks precede hashing. Both FDs close in finally.

All private JSON roles require an object. object_pairs_hook rejects duplicate fields at every nesting level; parse_constant rejects NaN/Infinity; allow_nan=False serialization also rejects1e999 overflow. Canonical sorted JSON comparison distinguishes bool/int/float and preserves unknown field values/types. YAML parsing is unsupported; no PyYAML dependency is added.

Proof stage path/SHA and full source object must type-sensitively equal validated stage values. Input profile/installed refs must equal stage baseline refs; their private files are re-read against current exact pins. Candidate filenames, path, SHA, exact0600 mode and bounded integer byte count are verified.

verified_source_boundaries.property: Profile command authority and single allowed change
verified_source_boundaries.evidence: Current profile requires a single main command with string command and exact old rollback facade argv. Candidate facade argv matches exact staged facade/contract/fixed loopback/token references. Expected candidate is deepcopy(current) with only mcp.commands[0].command replaced by shlex.join(exact staged argv), then compared type-sensitively to candidate.

release, facade_sha256, contract_sha256, tool_contract_catalog_sha256 and tools are independently derived from validated stage. Activation-plan updates must equal that exact map. Candidate installed manifest must equal deepcopy(current)+derived updates, preserving all other field types/values.

Administrator review, candidate start, live changes, restart, Refresh, token read/copy and full qualification assertions must be exactlyFalse; integer0/1 are refused. Preservation flags must be exactlyTrue and actual semantic comparisons still execute. A validated packet returns preparedTrue but administrator_review_completedFalse, statusHOLD and PRIVATE_PROFILE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; other holds remain.

Proof is validated before inventory and again after slower probes; canonical summaries must match. Prepared pins bind proof path/SHA. publish refuses optional args introduced/removed/changed since preparation, revalidates full stage and proof, and compares current summary before output creation.

Returned summary is a constructed whitelist of prepared/review status, format, artifact metadata and stage/source identifiers. Neither raw profile/installed JSON nor arbitrary proof.services_before is returned. No service control, candidate execution, live pointer modification or Refresh capability is added.

offline_evidence.original_60_method_AST_preservation: Parent-produced controlled-source manifest states unchanged. Reviewer did not independently execute AST comparison.
coverage_review: unknown/private settings and bool/int/float type drift
token alias and open-time token replacement before digest
offline_evidence.interpretation: Owned synthetic fixtures are regression evidence for this optional validator. They are not live private-profile review, production HTTP/SSH/service inventory, authorized activation, Refresh, cutover or full DC replacement qualification.

limits: No actual token, private packet, candidate raw actual profile or actual installed private profile was read by reviewer.

Private ownership is not a security boundary against code running under the same UID or higher privilege. FD/metadata/pin checks are consistency controls rather than atomic protection against arbitrary concurrent writers.
S.open_parent rejects symlink ancestry but does not establish every ancestor's trusted owner/mode or revalidate all ancestor pathname bindings after rename.
Checks cannot prevent changes after their final checkpoint; publication remains isolated and HOLD rather than live activation.
JSON-only handling deliberately rejects YAML input despite the legacy candidate-profile.yaml filename. No live packet compatibility was claimed or exercised.

reviewer_actions.final_receipt_delivery: Complete JSON collaboration message for parent create-only persistence.
